description:
1. Purpose
This is a Sources Sought Notice issued solely for market research in accordance with FAR Part 10. This notice does not constitute a solicitation. No award will be made based on this notice. The Government will not reimburse costs for responding.
The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Office of Women s Health (OWH), is seeking information from responsible and capable vendors to support delivery of the Women s Health Mini Residency for Rural Providers and Nurses. This training prepares rural clinicians to provide comprehensive, high quality women s health care across the VHA enterprise.
This notice is issued on an UNRESTRICTED basis. All qualified vendors are encouraged to respond.
2. Background
Women Veterans are a rapidly growing segment of the VHA patient population. Approximately 27% reside in rural or highly rural areas, where clinical training gaps continue to exist.
OWH has delivered Women s Health Mini Residency training since 2008, training over 14,000 clinicians. Ongoing training needs in rural and remote areas require expanded delivery of a specialized rural focused curriculum, including case based learning, hands on simulation, breast/pelvic exam training, and interprofessional facilitation.
3. Requirement
The Contractor will support delivery of the Women s Health Mini Residency for Rural Providers and Nurses at up to 40 rural sites nationwide over a 12 month period.
The full requirement, task details, staffing qualifications, deliverables, and performance standards are provided in the attached Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS). Vendors shall review the PWS for the complete description of required services.
High level capability areas include (but are not limited to):
Providing a trained team consisting of:
  Physician Instructor
  Nurse Instructor
  Gynecological Teaching Associate (GTA)
  Equipment Support Individual (ESI)
Delivering VA/OWH-developed curriculum via hybrid (virtual and in person) format
Attends Train the Trainer (TTT) workshops
Providing hands-on simulation instruction
Managing Government Furnished Equipment (GFE), including transport, inventory, and setup
Completing event documentation, sign in sheets, and post-training reports
Providing logistics, AV support, and nationwide travel
Ensuring 100% staffing coverage, including backup personnel.
4. Submission Requirements
Interested vendors shall submit a Capability Statement (PDF) not to exceed [5] pages including:
A. Company Information
Name, address
UEI and CAGE code
Business size under NAICS 611430
Point of Contact (name, phone, email)
B. Capability Narrative
Ability to meet all requirements in the attached PWS
Experience in clinical education, simulation, and nationwide training delivery
Experience providing qualified clinical instructors, GTAs, and ESIs
Logistics capability to support rural travel and complex equipment handling
Quality control and reporting approaches
C. Past Performance
At least two (2) similar programs/contracts within the past five (5) years
D. Additional Information
Organizational capacity
Subcontracting plans (if applicable)
5. Submission Instructions:
Email: Tereshia.burford@va.gov
Subject Line: 36C10X26Q0103   OWH Rural Mini Residency   Capability Statement   [Company Name]
Deadline: [April 1, 2026, at 5:00PM Eastern Time]
Questions: All questions regarding this notice are due at 5:00PM Eastern Time on Friday, March 25, 2026. Submit all questions using Attachment 2- Questions and Answers   Sources Sought 36C10X26Q0103 to email: Tereshia.burford@va.gov
Telephone inquiries will not be accepted.
6. Disclaimer
This Sources Sought Notice is for planning purposes only. It does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award. No contract will be awarded from this announcement. Vendors are advised not to submit proposals.
7. Attachments
Attachment 1   Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS)
Attachment 2 - Questions and Answers - Sources Sought 36C10X26Q0103.
